question:
Re-check these netdisk-pan records against their first-party pages: confirm what still holds, set the fields that changed, and record a dead host as dead with the evidence. Use one `confirm` per evidence row and name only the fields that row's quote proves; list every field you did not re-read in `unread`. Set a field only when the new page states a different value.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- netdisk-pan/xiaomi-cloud $.free_tier.unit: Page gives the tiers as '5G', not GiB; the unit GiB is not stated.
- netdisk-pan/telnyx-cloud-storage-egress-view $.egress.terms: Page says 'Egress fees | None' but not 'unmetered outbound bandwidth' or 'at all volumes'; the page says rates may vary by destination and volume tier and the headline scopes zero egress to inference/Telnyx services.
- netdisk-pan/samsung-cloud-storage $.free_tier.stated: Quote only says Gallery syncs to OneDrive. The 15 GB to 5 GB history, discontinuation and Drive migration are not on this page.
- netdisk-pan/telnyx-cloud-storage-egress-view $.price_per_tb_month: Page says $0.006 per GiB; 6.14 is per TiB (0.006*1024), not per TB. 'No egress at any volume' also not stated.
- netdisk-pan/telnyx-cloud-storage-egress-view $.egress.terms: Quote is the storage rate; it does not say anything on egress terms, unmetered bandwidth or volumes.
- netdisk-pan/xiaomi-cloud $.identity_cost.detail: Page is the Gallery sync termination notice. It says nothing on email-only accounts, +86 mobile binding, the 2048G tier or drive sync.
- netdisk-pan/samsung-cloud-storage $.free_tier.stated: Page shows the OneDrive 5 GB free plan only; Samsung's own free-tier history (15 GB, 5 GB, discontinued) is not on it.
- netdisk-pan/samsung-cloud-storage $.reliability_note: Page does not mention the 15 GB matched quota or its one-year duration.
- netdisk-pan/xiaomi-cloud $.free_tier.stated: 5G/50G/200G/2048G and 72/252/816 yuan per year are on the page, but the promo prices (CNY 239 to 408 for 2 TB) are not.
- netdisk-pan/samsung-cloud-storage $.chaining: Page shows Gallery sync to OneDrive and OneDrive 5 GB free; it does not say Samsung Cloud is 'literally OneDrive' or that the 15 GB no longer exists.
- netdisk-pan/yike-album $.free_tier.stated: Capture says '一刻相册 无限空间' only. The quoted sentence '图片存储可以用一刻相册，无限容量' and the word free are not on this capture.
